rawContent: In the wake of #MeToo campaign the most intriguing part is the fight betwn right wing & left wing taking sides for the victims & predators, it's like a tennis game "I served now ball is in your court, it's 1 each now, now it's 2 all" seriously the blame game is getting pathetic.

How ever I applause all the women who has the balls to speak up, specially Tanushree, kudos to her for the courage she has, and ppl who r saying she is doing it for publicity or for Bigg Boss or why she was quite for 10 yrs this is nothing but a victim shaming.
#MeToo 
3/3

Women folks this #MeToo campaign is not about defaming men just because u can, pls don't axe your personal grind, i don't approve of random anonymous lady making allegations, lend it some credibility by sharing your name, pls don't make it hard for actual sufferers.
